module: binaryheap: third-party library (Lua binary heap, used notably by copas for its timers) implementing a binary heap (priority queue). Two families: "plain heap" (minHeap/maxHeap, managed by position, values in heap.values) and "unique heap" (minUnique/maxUnique, each element has a unique `payload` found in O(1) via heap.reverse). The module returns the table M.
usage:
local bh = require("libs/binaryheap/binaryheap")
local h = bh.minUnique()
h:insert(5, "b")
h:insert(2, "a")
print(h:pop()) --> "a", 2
notes: In a unique heap, the payload must be unique and non-nil (insert raises "duplicate payload" otherwise); update/remove take the payload, not the position.
pop returns the payload first then the value (unique heap); on a plain heap, pop returns the value.
The default comparison function is a < b (min) or a > b (max).

binaryHeap.desc: Core of all the queues: builds a heap from swap, erase and comparison functions. Returns a table with the methods bubbleUp(pos) and sinkDown(pos) and the lists values and payloads.

swap.desc: swap(heap, idx1, idx2) swaps two elements

lt.desc: lt(a, b) true when a must be above b

minHeap.desc: Creates a plain heap with the smallest value at the top.

maxHeap.desc: Creates a plain heap with the largest value at the top.

minUnique.desc: Creates a heap with unique payloads, smallest value at the top.

maxUnique.desc: Creates a heap with unique payloads, largest value at the top.

h.desc: Methods of the heaps created by minHeap/maxHeap (by position) and minUnique/maxUnique (by payload). For a unique heap, the parameters named payload replace positions.

insert.desc: Inserts an element. On a unique heap, raises an error if the payload already exists.

update.desc: Changes an element's value and puts it back in place in the heap.

remove.desc: Removes an element from the heap.

returns.desc: Removed value, then payload (unique); nil if not found

pop.desc: Removes and returns the top of the heap.

returns.desc: Payload (unique heap), then value; nil if empty

peek.desc: Returns the top without removing it.

returns.desc: Payload (unique heap), then value; nil if empty

peekValue.desc: Returns the top value without removing it (unique heap).

size.desc: Number of elements in the heap.

valueByPayload.desc: Returns the value associated with a payload (unique heap).

heap.desc: Low-level methods of the base heap (inferred from code: swap and erase passed to binaryHeap).

swap.desc: Swaps the elements at positions a and b.

erase.desc: Brutally erases the element at position pos.
